about: Detector-native settings of the generic compute levels used by the SCI + V7f layer. Resolutions are the three levels of the historical hand-designed AC-MOT controller (core.Controller: 640 / 736 / 832 px) and the levels cached for both detectors (outputs/det_cache_*_native: det_640, det_736, det_832). The reference operating point of the V7f record is 736 px (tools/v7/dev.py).
